column1: # Manual decisions on Recovery Version substitutions (tools/rcv_prefs.py).
#   apply = OpenCC wrote a char the RcV never uses for that simplified char: replace it everywhere (glyph variants
#           only; reviewed 2026-10-02 against the lyrics where the rule fires)
#   keep  = never replace the OpenCC char with this RcV char
#   always = replace the OpenCC char everywhere, with or without RcV evidence (user decision)
# Not listed: context rows and char rules apply; the "never in the RcV" rule does not (云 in 所云 is not 雲).
